blocks.text: John Arcilla has demanded justice for the 29 dogs and cats found dumped in a vacant lot in San Jose del Monte in Bulacan, as he called for a thorough investigation of pet crematoriums across the country following the incident. In two social media posts over the weekend, Arcilla described the incident as a crime and accused questionable pet crematoriums of deceiving pet owners who pay for the proper cremation of their deceased animals. “Ito ay isang krimen,” he said in his first post. “Kailangang panagutan at makulong ang mga may gawa nito.
